title: InventoryStockChangedPayload
description: Payload of the inventory.stock_changed event (routing key inventory.stock_changed), wrapped in envelope.v1.json. Published by Inventory whenever a product's available stock changes (reservation, release, restock); consumed by Ordering to maintain its availability projection.

available.description: Absolute stock level after the change (not a delta), so a replayed or reordered event cannot corrupt the projection beyond staleness
